gaps: It does not state quantities for these parts.
The Compressor Parts page gives no ratings for the compressor or the overload protector.
Cover page also lists 345 next to BTU-COOLING, meaning unclear.
method: Source: Frigidaire Factory Parts Catalog, publication 5995348280, dated 06/01, (c)2001 White Consolidated Industries, 12 pages, read on ManualsLib.

ManualsLib's text extraction prints the position numbers, part numbers and descriptions as separate blocks; rows were paired by order, and the counts matched on every page used (compressor parts p. 9, controls p. 5, air handling p. 7).
The catalog names Goldstar as the compressor maker and Sagem for the power PC board.
Qty on extra parts is editorial (one part number listed per position).
